architecture_decisions: Typed Project-scoped, read-only-first Playwright-backed browser capability layer for Parallax evidence collection.
work_items: Define a browser capability layer for Parallax application evidence collection.
validations: Ensure browser actions are server-owned typed capabilities, callers/models cannot submit arbitrary commands or JavaScript.
AC-01: validate protected requirement — Every browser action resolves through an immutable registered v1 capability; unknown/arbitrary actions are denied before browser execution.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Browser requests bind authenticated canonical Project/run/context and server-owned admitted target identity; cross-Project or caller-invented target authority fails closed.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — Navigation to or redirect toward an unadmitted origin is denied without exposing generic network authority.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — The public/internal capability contract provides no arbitrary script/eval surface; assertions are declarative and allowlisted.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Tests prove credentials, cookies, authorization headers, password-store data and server secret environment values cannot be requested or serialized as browser evidence.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — Tests prove v1 exposes no capability for purchases, destructive submissions, deletion, account changes or other external-state mutation.
AC-07: validate protected requirement — DOM/accessibility inspection is normalized and bounded; full unbounded page/DOM payload is not retained as canonical evidence.
AC-08: validate protected requirement — Screenshot evidence binds exact context/target/viewport/digest and preserves existing privacy/redaction policy.
AC-09: validate protected requirement — Browser evidence cannot override failed protected deterministic validation for the same candidate/source context.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Sessions are ephemeral, Project-bound, bounded in resource/action/time use and reliably destroyed on success/failure/timeout; state cannot leak across Projects.
AC-11: validate protected requirement — Policy denial, browser error and timeout are distinct bounded outcomes and can never be serialized as success.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Browser v1 grants no source acceptance, Engineering Run lifecycle, arbitrary network, provider administration, merge/deploy, approval or REVIEW completion authority.

AC-13: validate protected requirement — S4 semantic implementation cannot begin until Control Tower accepts W7-S1. Before integration, S4 reconciles to the latest accepted Wave 7 integration head, commits authentic DSPy evidence for `P2-V0.20.4`, passes protected spec validation and applicable exact-head gates, then stops `READY FOR INTEGRATION`.
risks: No arbitrary browsing, JavaScript, network, credential or destructive-action authority introduced.
